name: DXY Forecasting Dataset
description: A multivariate monthly time series dataset designed for forecasting the US Dollar Index (DXY) using macroeconomic and financial indicators including interest rates, volatility indices, exchange rates, and trade balance data from FRED. The dataset includes engineered features such as interest rate differentials and log-transformed variables.
measurementTechnique: Data cleaning, monthly resampling, time-series alignment, feature engineering (log transformations, differencing, and rate differentials)
